title: Course – Bank of America Chicago Marathon
claims: The course starts and finishes in Grant Park and travels through 29 Chicago neighbourhoods.
The organiser describes the course as flat and fast and says it has produced seven world records, with 1.7 million spectators.
The 2026 course page links to an official course-map PDF and states that the course map is subject to change.

There are 20 aid stations approximately one to two miles apart, and each provides a medical tent with runner transport, standard and ADA toilets, Gatorade Endurance Formula, a public-address announcer and water.
Medical support is available at 22 on-course locations, including medical tents at all 20 aid stations plus additional tents between miles 14 and 15 and in the final mile.
The course time limit is 6 hours 30 minutes, a 15-minute-per-mile pace.
Timing checkpoints are at the start, each 5K, the halfway point at 13.1 miles, miles 20–25, mile 25.2 and the finish.
The event is recognised as a World Athletics Platinum Label road race.
The page does not publish a cumulative elevation gain or descent figure.
